goal: Clarify the test-review TOOLING_FAILURE recovery procedure so operators can complete the step with structured completion override evidence when they intentionally proceed with accepted risk.

in: test-review non-normal completion guidance after TOOLING_FAILURE
Finding disposition values and accepted_risk usage
Related task or issue-log evidence recording for accepted-risk recovery
Next-action prompt source for plan-phase test-review instructions
out: Changing PASS, ADVISORY, FAIL, or TOOLING_FAILURE verdict routing
Relaxing completion override validation or changing the override schema
Changing AI review parser behavior or retry limits
Adding a new CLI helper for writing completion overrides
Regenerating the full docs/ tree as a required deliverable

constraints: No external dependencies may be added; implementation and tests must use Node.js built-ins and existing local helpers.
The existing completion validation contract must remain unchanged: test-review normal completion is limited to PASS and ADVISORY, while non-normal completion requires valid override evidence.
The procedure text must remain generic and must not include project-specific values under src/.
Detailed per-step recovery procedure must live in the next-action prompt source, not in the thin dispatcher skill.
Source is newer than docs in this worktree, so implementation decisions must treat source code as authoritative.
design_principles: Document the existing recovery contract instead of expanding the CLI surface.
Make the recovery evidence shape copyable and verifiable from the procedure text.
Keep issue-log as audit context and completion-overrides.json as the structured unlock evidence.

modules.text: `src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js` owns completion override validation and the required evidence shape.
`src/flow/lib/run-review.js` records issue-log audit entries when test-review returns TOOLING_FAILURE and emits related recovery text in tooling-failure artifacts.

data_flow.text: When test-review returns PASS or ADVISORY, the registry hook marks test-review done. When it returns TOOLING_FAILURE, the hook leaves test-review open and records issue-log audit evidence.

A later attempt to set test-review done loads specs/<id>/completion-overrides.json, reads entries.test-review, validates OverrideCompletionEvidence, and allows completion only when that structured evidence is valid.

decisions.text: [VERIFY] test-review normal completion is PASS or ADVISORY only.
decisions.evidence: src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js StepCompletionPolicy.defaultPolicies defines test-review allowedVerdicts as ["PASS", "ADVISORY"]. src/flow/registry.js marks test-review done only for PASS or ADVISORY in review phase test.

decisions.text: [VERIFY] TOOLING_FAILURE records audit evidence but does not complete test-review.
decisions.evidence: src/flow/registry.js routes test-review TOOLING_FAILURE to appendIssueLogFromTestReviewToolingFailure. src/flow/lib/run-review.js writes step=test-review, phase=test, failureKind=tooling_failure, reason, resolution, artifact, and timestamp.

decisions.text: [VERIFY] completion override evidence already has a strict schema.
decisions.evidence: src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js OverrideCompletionEvidence requires userApproval=true, reason, approvedAt, approvedBy, and non-empty findings[]. FindingDisposition requires findingId, disposition, successorOwner, and acceptedRisk.

decisions.text: [VERIFY] sdd-forge.flow is a thin dispatcher, so detailed test-review procedure belongs in next-action prompt content.
decisions.evidence: src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md says per-step procedures live in sdd-forge flow get next-action and the skill itself does not encode per-step sequencing.

decisions.text: Limit this spec to procedure clarity, not CLI automation.
decisions.evidence: Issue #359 asks to add required fields, disposition, and related task recording to the non-normal completion procedure. The source already validates completion override evidence.
decisions.consideredAlternatives: A CLI helper for writing completion-overrides.json was rejected because it expands behavior beyond the issue and is not required to prevent the documented failure.

decisions.text: Require both structured override evidence and an audit/task trail in the procedure.
decisions.evidence: completion-overrides.json is required by validateStepCompletionTransition; issue-log entries are already written for TOOLING_FAILURE and provide the recovery audit trail.

background: Issue #359 reports that after repeated test-review parser_error failures, an attempt to mark test-review done failed because completion-overrides.json did not exist. The implementation already supports structured completion override evidence, but the test-review non-normal completion procedure only says to record explicit evidence. It does not state the required override artifact fields, allowed disposition values, or how to keep the related recovery task/audit trail discoverable.

requirements.desc: The test-review non-normal completion procedure must state that TOOLING_FAILURE is not a test-quality failure, does not complete test-review by itself, and requires either tooling recovery or structured completion override evidence before proceeding.
The procedure must document the completion-overrides.json location and entries.test-review required fields: userApproval=true, reason, approvedAt, approvedBy, and a non-empty findings array.

The procedure must document each finding entry field: findingId, disposition, successorOwner, and acceptedRisk; must list the allowed disposition values out_of_scope, transferred_to_successor, accepted_risk, and false_positive; and must define a stable synthetic findingId convention for TOOLING_FAILURE cases with no parsed review finding, such as test-review:tooling_failure:<toolingFailure>.

The procedure must state that accepted_risk recovery needs an audit or task trail, using the existing issue-log TOOLING_FAILURE entry or an explicit related task reference, and that free-text issue-log alone is not completion override evidence.

Spec-local tests must verify that the updated guidance includes the required override artifact fields, allowed disposition values, accepted_risk audit/task guidance, and the free-text issue-log boundary.

acceptance_criteria: test-review guidance contains a TOOLING_FAILURE recovery subsection or equivalent text that distinguishes tooling failure from test-quality failure.
The guidance names specs/<id>/completion-overrides.json and entries.test-review as the structured evidence location for test-review override completion.
The guidance lists userApproval=true, reason, approvedAt, approvedBy, and findings[] as required override fields.
The guidance lists findingId, disposition, successorOwner, and acceptedRisk as required finding fields.
The guidance defines a stable synthetic findingId convention for TOOLING_FAILURE artifacts with no parsed review finding, including parser_error cases.
The guidance lists out_of_scope, transferred_to_successor, accepted_risk, and false_positive as allowed disposition values.
The guidance states that accepted_risk must be tied to an issue-log entry or related task reference and that free-text issue-log alone does not satisfy completion override validation.
Spec-local tests under specs/280-issue-359-test-review-completion-override/tests/ include a `// spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5` header and fail before the guidance is updated.

clarifications.q: Should this change add a CLI helper to create completion-overrides.json?
clarifications.a: No. Issue #359 targets unclear recovery procedure text. The existing validator already consumes completion-overrides.json, so this spec documents that contract instead of adding behavior.

clarifications.q: Does accepted_risk mean issue-log alone can complete test-review?
clarifications.a: No. issue-log is audit context. completion-overrides.json remains the structured evidence required by completion validation.

clarifications.q: Does this change alter test-review verdict routing?
clarifications.a: No. PASS and ADVISORY remain normal completion, FAIL remains a test-design blocker, and TOOLING_FAILURE remains a tooling recovery path.

clarifications.q: Where should detailed recovery procedure be tested?
clarifications.a: Against src/flow/prompts/plan/test-review.md, the next-action prompt source for the plan/test-review step. The thin dispatcher skill should not duplicate per-step recovery instructions.

alternatives_considered.option: Add a CLI helper to write completion override evidence
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because the issue asks for reusable recovery procedure clarity, and adding a command would expand the behavioral surface.

alternatives_considered.option: Relax completion validation when issue-log has a tooling_failure entry
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because free-text issue-log is not structured override evidence and would weaken the completion contract.

alternatives_considered.option: Document only the existence of completion-overrides.json
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because the reported failure came from missing operational details: required fields, disposition, and related task recording.
